name: Mercury 2
short: Inception Labs' Feb 2026 diffusion LLM (dLLM): parallel block refinement hits 500-1,000 tok/s, 128K/50K at $0.25/$0.75 — but SWE-bench 24.8% keeps it to light coding.
pricingTiers: Inception list $0.25/M in, $0.75/M out, $0.025/M cached input
standout: Pioneer diffusion decoder: 500-1,000 tok/s makes it ideal for real-time voice agents and short sub-agent loops.
tradeoff: Early dLLM coherence variance — weak repository-scale coding (SWE-bench 24.8%) and modest tool-use reliability vs autoregressive peers.
